title: Polynomial time is closed under union
statement: Let $L_1$ and $L_2$ be languages of finite Boolean words, each in $\mathsf{P}$. Then their union $\{z : z\in L_1\text{ or }z\in L_2\}$ is also in $\mathsf{P}$.
hypotheses_covered: $L_1,L_2$ are languages of finite Boolean words
replaced: Let $L_1, L_2 \subseteq \{0,1\}^*$ be languages in $\mathsf{P}$, the class of languages decidable by a deterministic Turing machine in polynomial time. Then their union $L_1 \cup L_2 = \{z : z \in L_1 \text{ or } z \in L_2\}$ also belongs to $\mathsf{P}$.
